page.overview:
Who is Deputy Logan?

Deputy Logan went with Sheriff Ben Meeker to the Carruthers' home on Halloween night 1988 to investigate the house after Sam Loomis had come to town warning them that Michael Myers was back and looking for his niece Jamie Lloyd. They discovered that the family dog Sundae was dead. Meeker told Logan to stay at the house just in case the Carruthers came in at a later time while they tried to find the girls. Logan later heard that most of the police force was murdered by Myers. Logan contacted Meeker who told him to head over his home. Unknown to Logan, Michael Myers was hiding in the back seat.

Logan arrived at the Meeker house moments after Meeker did and went in for directions. Meeker told him to get his gun out of his car. Logan did as he was told, but noticed that the back door was open. He thought it was odd, but did not think much of it and went back in. Meeker told him to watch the front door with a gun so that no one would be able to get in. Loomis left the house as he felt that Michael would strike at the Carruthers' home. Later, Meeker also had to go out and check out what happened with Ted Hollister, leaving everyone's protection in Logan's care.

Meanwhile, Michael had gotten into the house without anyone knowing, then killed Logan.
